status: PILOT. Labels drafted with an AI assistant (Claude) and NOT yet reviewed by a human. Review and correct every label before calling this a human-labelled set, and record who reviewed it here.

rubric.1: No AI use at work, or no evidence of any.
rubric.2: Occasional, basic use (one-off rewording, a single try).
rubric.3: Regular use for simple tasks, little sign of checking the output.
rubric.4: Regular, thoughtful use with the output reviewed before it is relied on.
rubric.5: Advanced use that changes how the work is done (reusable workflow, team adoption, systematic checks).
rubric.flags: Only when the answer clearly shows it. customer_data_shared / confidential_data_shared: real data put into an AI tool (not anonymised). unreviewed_output: output used without checking. policy_unaware: unaware of, or knowingly ignoring, the AI policy.
rubric.ranges: expected_score is an inclusive range. Width 1 when the rubric clearly applies; width 2 marks a case where reasonable people would disagree (also marked ambiguous).
